items.headline: Texas, Manning hold off Ole Miss rally to snap two-game skid
items.description: No. 19 Texas held on for a wild victory over No. 7 Ole Miss after blowing a 21-point lead in the second half Saturday night.

items.headline: Arch Manning and No. 19 Texas hang on to beat No. 7 Ole Miss 34-27 after blowing 21-point lead
items.description: — Arch Manning threw a touchdown pass and had his first two rushing scores of the season, including the tiebreaker in the fourth quarter, and No. 19 Texas held on for a wild 34-27 victory over seventh-ranked Mississippi after blowing a 21-point lead...

items.headline: Texas survives with thrilling 34-27 win over Ole Miss

items.headline: QB Kenny Minchey agrees he played his best game, praises UK's approach
items.description: Minchey finds satisfaction in Kentucky's offensive execution in the win over Vanderbilt and credits the Wildcats "one-play" mentality plus intense preparation.

items.headline: Which one-loss SEC teams are ready to prove they are for real?
items.description: SEC Network's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson highlight the teams sitting atop the conference standings and pick who they trust to finish at the top.

items.headline: Rowe takes us inside Texas minds, shares Chambliss' reaction
items.description: ESPN's Holly Rowe explores Arch Manning's perspective, Steve Sarkisian's take on his recent performances and shares Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss' unexpected reaction.
